title: Seoul shares soar over 4% to snap 3-day slide on tech rally, oil prices fall
caption:
South Korean stocks rallied over 4% on Tuesday, snapping a three-day losing streak as oil prices fell. Tech giants and airlines led the gains following international geopolitical updates.
